{"file_text":"# hvir

A lightweight, view-first workbench for agentic development.

`hvir` is a modern desktop environment built for developer workflows where AI agents, terminals, code viewers, diffs, and live previews work together seamlessly.

---

## Key Features

- **View-First Workbench**: Optimized for reviewing agent-generated code changes, side-by-side file diffs, markdown rendering, and live output without context switching.
- **Terminal Workspaces & Agent Harness**: Multi-pane terminal environment powered by Ghostty and `node-pty`, with built-in support for agent harnesses (including Claude Code, Gemini, Codex, and custom AI tools).
- **Remote Workspaces via SSH**: Access local or remote developer environments transparently over SSH with secure host identity management and remote file and terminal transport.
- **Integrated Git Workflows**: Built-in Git status, visual graph view, diff inspections via CodeMirror, branch/worktree management, and commit operations.
- **Rich Document & Live Previews**: Markdown rendering with GFM task lists, Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math typesetting, and web-pane live previews via loopback HTTP proxy.
- **Sessions Projection & Health Diagnostics**: Real-time tracking of agent session states, token usage, telemetry, self-monitoring runtime health checks, and automated renderer recovery.

---

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: [Electron](https://www.electronjs.org/), [React 19](https://react.dev/), [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)
- **Build Tool**: [electron-vite](https://electron-vite.org/), [Vite](https://vitejs.dev/)
- **Terminal**: `ghostty-web`, [`node-pty`](https://github.com/microsoft/node-pty)
- **Code & Diff Viewing**: [CodeMirror](https://codemirror.net/), [Shiki](https://shiki.style/)
- **Testing**: [Vitest](https://vitest.dev/), [Stryker Mutator](https://stryker-mutator.io/)

---

## Prerequisites

- **Node.js**: Version `24.0.0` or higher
- **npm**: Version `10.0.0` or higher

---

## Quick Start

### Installation

Clone the repository and install dependencies:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jarmak-personal/hvir.git
cd hvir
npm install
```

> Note: The `postinstall` script automatically compiles native dependencies (`node-pty` and `@hvir/rename-noreplace`).

### Development

Run `hvir` in development mode with hot-module replacement:

```bash
npm run dev
```

### Production Build

Typecheck and build the production bundle:

```bash
npm run build
```

Package for your operating system:

```bash
# macOS (ARM64)
npm run pack:mac:arm64

# Linux (x64)
npm run pack:linux:x64

# Linux (ARM64)
npm run pack:linux:arm64
```

---

## Development Scripts

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run dev` | Start Electron application in development mode |
| `npm run build` | Run type checking and build production bundle |
| `npm test` | Run unit and integration tests with Vitest |
| `npm run typecheck` | Run TypeScript type checks across main and web contexts |
| `npm run lint` | Lint codebase with ESLint |
| `npm run format` | Format codebase using Prettier |
| `npm run verify` | Run complete verification suite (seams, ADRs, architecture, lint, typecheck, test) |
| `npm run smoke` | Run smoke test scenarios for core subsystems |

---

## Directory Structure

```text
hvir/
├── build/                # Icon assets and build configurations
├── packages/             # Native support packages (@hvir/rename-noreplace)
├── scripts/              # Build, release, smoke testing, and maintenance scripts
├── src/
│   ├── main/             # Electron main process (lifecycle, IPC, SSH, PTY supervisor, harness)
│   ├── preload/          # Context isolation bridge scripts
│   ├── renderer/         # React front-end UI (workbench, views, terminals, settings)
│   ├── shared/           # Cross-process types, IPC contracts, and utilities
│   └── workers/          # Background worker host processes (Git, echo)
└── test/                 # Test suites, fixtures, and scenario tests
```

---

## License

This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

```bash
npm run dev
```

### Production Build

Typecheck and build the production bundle:

```bash
npm run build
```

Package for your operating system:

```bash
# macOS (ARM64)
npm run pack:mac:arm64

# Linux (x64)
npm run pack:linux:x64

# Linux (ARM64)
npm run pack:linux:arm64
```

---

## Development Scripts

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run dev` | Start Electron application in development mode |
| `npm run build` | Run type checking and build production bundle |
| `npm test` | Run unit and integration tests with Vitest |
| `npm run typecheck` | Run TypeScript type checks across main and web contexts |
| `npm run lint` | Lint codebase with ESLint |
| `npm run format` | Format codebase using Prettier |
| `npm run verify` | Run complete verification suite (seams, ADRs, architecture, lint, typecheck, test) |
| `npm run smoke` | Run smoke test scenarios for core subsystems |

---

## Directory Structure

```text
hvir/
├── build/                # Icon assets and build configurations
├── packages/             # Native support packages (@hvir/rename-noreplace)
├── scripts/              # Build, release, smoke testing, and maintenance scripts
├── src/
│   ├── main/             # Electron main process (lifecycle, IPC, SSH, PTY supervisor, harness)
│   ├── preload/          # Context isolation bridge scripts
│   ├── renderer/         # React front-end UI (workbench, views, terminals, settings)
│   ├── shared/           # Cross-process types, IPC contracts, and utilities
│   └── workers/          # Background worker host processes (Git, echo)
└── test/                 # Test suites, fixtures, and scenario tests
```

---

+# hvir
+
+A lightweight, view-first workbench for agentic development.
+
+`hvir` is a modern desktop environment built for developer workflows where AI agents, terminals, code viewers, diffs, and live previews work together seamlessly.
+
+---
+
+## Key Features
+
+- **View-First Workbench**: Optimized for reviewing agent-generated code changes, side-by-side file diffs, markdown rendering, and live output without context switching.
+- **Terminal Workspaces & Agent Harness**: Multi-pane terminal environment powered by Ghostty and `node-pty`, with built-in support for agent harnesses (including Claude Code, Gemini, Codex, and custom AI tools).
+- **Remote Workspaces via SSH**: Access local or remote developer environments transparently over SSH with secure host identity management and remote file and terminal transport.
+- **Integrated Git Workflows**: Built-in Git status, visual graph view, diff inspections via CodeMirror, branch/worktree management, and commit operations.
+- **Rich Document & Live Previews**: Markdown rendering with GFM task lists, Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math typesetting, and web-pane live previews via loopback HTTP proxy.
+- **Sessions Projection & Health Diagnostics**: Real-time tracking of agent session states, token usage, telemetry, self-monitoring runtime health checks, and automated renderer recovery.
+
+---

+- **Framework**: [Electron](https://www.electronjs.org/), [React 19](https://react.dev/), [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)

+- **Terminal**: `ghostty-web`, [`node-pty`](https://github.com/microsoft/node-pty)
+- **Code & Diff Viewing**: [CodeMirror](https://codemirror.net/), [Shiki](https://shiki.style/)
